removed_lines: two earthquakes of magnitude 7.2 and 7.5 struck venezuela on 24 june, collapsing over 200 buildings and leaving over 80,000 homeless. around 14,000 have lost their lives, up to 17,000 have been injured and 50,000 remain missing as emergency teams continue search and rescue operations. many people sleep outdoors without water, electricity or knowing when they will be able to return home. but there are not an allocation of funds to reach those who need it most as quickly as possible.

families have lost loved ones, homes have been damaged or destroyed and many people are unsure where they will find shelter or support in the days ahead. your donation will help provide emergency assistance to those affected and support communities as they begin to recover. every donation will help bring hope, relief and practical support to people whose lives have been turned upside down.
